breakdown.description: The setup uses B32 elements, but the deck uses M3D8 elements.

The ground truth resolves this by prioritizing the input deck. The agent correctly followed this logic, generating an input file that uses 'TYPE=M3D8' and ignoring the contradictory prose instruction.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global y-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global z-direction.
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt stated the load 'acts in the global y-direction', but the input deck specified '*CLOAD 1,3,-1.e-3', which applies the load in the z-direction (degree of freedom 3). The ground truth treats the input deck as the authoritative source. The agent correctly generated the input file with the load applied in the z-direction, thereby resolving the inconsistency.
